aboutIntro: As a premier global community in artificial intelligence and high-performance computing, HyperAI (hyper.ai) is committed to supporting developers and enthusiasts across the global data science and AI industry by providing a comprehensive suite of services — including industry news reports, accelerated dataset downloads, online tutorials, benchmarks of leading AI models, curated recommendations of cutting-edge research papers, in-depth interpretations of high-impact results and integration with top conference calendars. HyperAI empowers developers to explore, comprehend and apply AI, driving innovation and shaping the future of artificial intelligence together with the community.

@aboutIntro.description: The first paragraph of what HyperAI is, from hyper.ai's About page.

aboutContent: In terms of platform content, HyperAI not only provides real-time coverage of trending topics in the global artificial intelligence industry, but also closely follows top journals such as Nature and Science, as well as international academic conferences including CVPR, ICLR and NeurIPS, curating and recommending high-quality, cutting-edge research papers. In addition, we focus on the field of AI for Science, and have produced in-depth analyses of over 200 research findings so far. These are published through our open-source project Awesome AI for Science on GitHub, covering a broad spectrum of key domains such as materials chemistry, biopharmaceuticals, astrophysics, urban planning and weather forecasting.

@aboutContent.description: The second paragraph of what HyperAI is: its content. Awesome AI for Science is the name of a project, and stays as it is.

aboutResources: In terms of resources, HyperAI integrates high-quality datasets and open-source projects from around the world to provide developers with a comprehensive resource hub, lowering the learning curve for newcomers and enabling experienced engineers to train and optimize models more efficiently. In parallel, we offer performance evaluations of leading AI models and cutting-edge GPUs to help practitioners stay current with the latest developments in both software and hardware.
